about: Moves keyboard focus past a repeated block of content. `SkipNav.Link` is hidden until keyboard focus, and `SkipNav.Target` receives focus when the link is followed.

pair.about: An invoice list whose skip link moves focus past the filters to the results. Press Tab into the scene: the link appears at the start corner of the list, and Enter moves focus to the results.
